about_the_game:
A hero, returning to his native village after years of loyal service to the king, discovers that home is forever changed. The once-omnipotent elves have fled the castle in terror, leaving their horrific creation to torment nearby folk — and only a soul as dark as the keep itself can cross its threshold…

  • Immersive-Sim freedom — wield a full arsenal of spells to shape the world, charge straight in, or vanish into the shadows; the choice is always yours.

  • Retro dark-fantasy flair — 90s-style pixel textures blend with modern lighting and particle effects.

  • Limitless arsenal — arcane weapons, alchemy, improvised traps—or bare fists, if you dare.

  • Meaningful choices — shape the characters’ destinies and the story’s ending… or let the ending shape you.

    What awaits you in the game:

  •  A first-person immersive RPG: exploration, stealth, combat, and magic.

  • Semi-open locations: alternative routes, stashes, and secrets.

  • Stealth and lockpicking: noise affects detection; locks, traps, and hidden passages.

  • Melee and ranged combat: blades, bows, and magic against enemies with varied behaviors.

  • Alchemy and crafting.

  • Character progression: skills and perks tailored to your style; choices with consequences, multiple paths and endings.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i3
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1050
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Can the Hero reach the donjon of the dark castle looming over the village he once called home? An immersive first-person RPG with old-school graphics.

English*, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian*, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Spain, French
